title: KAITO — Supportive Through Struggles〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: An after-party?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! I thought we should start preparing to celebrate when Toya finishes writing all of his songs!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself?
He only just finished making his first one.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, there's nothing wrong with starting early! I mean, I want it to be a big celebration!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I do understand what you're saying...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
So, MEIKO!
I have a little favor to ask of you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heya!
Sorry for being late, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin, there you are!
I've been waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm starved!
So, what did you need me to taste test?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, wow! These cookies!
They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How did you get the center to look like red flowers?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Would you like to know?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: First, you turn the cookie dough red by mixing in a little strawberry powder!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, turn more dough into other colors that you need, roll them out into long sticks...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, are you gonna stack them together?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Precisely! Once that's done, let it sit in the refrigerator for a little while, cut them into thin slices and throw them in the oven! That's how you get a whole pile of the same cookies when they're done!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so cool! No matter where you cut, you get the same cookie!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To be fair, MEIKO showed me how to do all this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
They're called icebox cookies.
It's fun to make them because of all the color and flavor combinations you can have.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Don't you think you made a little too many?
I mean, this table is literally covered in your cookies.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What she said!
Why did you have to go and turn this cafe into a cookie carnival?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! When did you two get here?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Uhh...
Before you came, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-You don't look so good? Are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'm just...so full...
We've already had around a hundred of these...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! A hundred?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The thing is, I had trouble picking just one design...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Strawberries gave me red, mangoes gave me yellow, matcha gave me green... But they're all different flavors, so you have to be careful with your choice of colors.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which is why I tried making several different types of cookies...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No one said that you had to bake this many! I was happy at first, but now I'm completely tired of them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hate to break it to all of you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I just took some more out of the oven.

rows.Speaker: Luka & Len
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, the cookie dough you're making right now isn't going to fit in the fridge. You'll need to bake the ones that are already in there first...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's start baking those next...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: T-Tomorrow! We can snack on them then!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I don't think my stomach can handle any more today!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
N-No, wait!
Rin just got here, so hang in there!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't forget that we're doing this for Toya...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For me...? What are you all talking about?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?! Toya?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is...a lot of cookies.
Are you all having a party or something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, the truth is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. You were preparing an after-party for me when I finished writing all those songs.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
To think that you'd find out so soon...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It's okay, KAITO!
I thought your idea was really good!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. You seemed genuinely excited about doing something that would make Toya smile.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But he went completely overboard.
He even got the floor all covered in flour.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He did clean it up in a hurry since he was afraid of being scolded by MEIKO. Unfortunately, she found out right as he was about to finish.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hey, wait!
He doesn't need to know about any of that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's just... I got so excited after hearing your song, Toya, that I felt that we needed to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You took in your teammates' thoughts, feelings, experiences, and even took a hard look at your own... Despite any painful memories that you had to relive, you still managed to complete your song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which is why I wanted to give you a pat on the back and say, “Job well done!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I forgot to make sure to keep it a surprise...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, don't say that.
I really appreciate what you were doing, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, now that I know you want to throw me a party, I feel even more motivated to produce more good songs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So, I promise to keep doing my best.
And I'll very much be looking forward to this celebration.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Hear that, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes!
And I promise to throw you the best after-party ever!
